supersession_reason: Output metadata described an absent plate/web seam and un-applied virtual cross-work ambiguously; raw development output remains preserved.

plate_only.load: 100 N Fy at the physical top of a clamped 1 by 0.2 by 0.035 m plate

web_only.load: 10 Nm Mx on a clamped 1 by 0.01 by 0.2 m web

effective_threads: CalculiX reported one CPU; native process reported two one-thread OpenBLAS pools
independent_review: Read-only review found no deck-isolation, load, support or native-block extraction defect. The S4 plate-only result is below the S4 coupled plate work, so removal of the web is not an exact additive counterfactual preserving the S4 plate operator and load map.
decision: Isolated element/section differences are material and opposing for web torque, but do not uniquely allocate the coupled gap. Stop refinement and multiplier tuning. A verified sided interface work/action reference or equivalent operator partition is required to decide whether to revise the continuous L1 law or its discrete enforcement.
limitations: The isolated controls do not recover shared-seam traction or rotational support reactions.
An S4 welded junction and native exact weak L1 line are distinct idealizations.
One level and these controls do not qualify F03, select A/B, or prove a formulation defect.
